items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I used to work out with Kid Greaves and Joe Mandots.

ctx.x: then, for dance, it's the same thing. They split them up, the kids? Oh, no. Sometimes all the kids played

with, uh, possibly two grown-ups, the old man Lane, Jack. Uh, I remember when, when I had a fight with Pansy on the Canal Street Fern. You see, he cut this, see that cut? Yeah, you told me about that. How'd that happen? Well, he, he was looking for trouble, and I tried to give it to him. Before I could put it on his jaw, he ripped me with a knife. I didn't know he had a knife. Well, you're damn lucky you didn't cut your tendons, man. Well, I was lucky, because I had this hand straight up. Of course, in those…
Jack style. I never let him play, uh, uh, drum. Do you remember it at all? Oh, Jack Lane? Yeah. Well, you mean orchestra, huh? No, I mean band work, either for dance or for, uh, marching.
